SELECT p.project_sq, p.project_ttl, c.company_nm, p.project_salary, p.project_start_dt, p.project_end_dt,
CASE WHEN p.project_end_dt < CURDATE() THEN '완료' WHEN p.project_start_dt <= CURDATE() AND p.project_end_dt >= CURDATE() THEN '진행중' WHEN p.project_recruit_start_dt <= CURDATE() AND p.project_recruit_end_dt >= CURDATE() THEN '모집중' WHEN p.project_recruit_end_dt < CURDATE() AND p.project_start_dt > CURDATE() THEN '모집마감' ELSE '예정' END AS project_status FROM TBL_PROJECT_M p LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON p.company_sq = c.company_sq WHERE p.project_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY p.project_sq DESC
